nodes.title: Automatic PiP composite on stop
nodes.summary: Produce final.mp4 with the screen as the main video and the presenter in a small bottom-right overlay (default about 320 px wide, 20 px margin). The final audio mixes the presenter's mic and the system audio.

nodes.title: Keep the raw files
nodes.summary: Save each session in a timestamped folder containing camera.mp4, screen.mp4, and final.mp4 so recordings can be re-composited later.

nodes.title: Reliable file output
nodes.summary: Stopping must always finalize the files cleanly, with no corrupt or unplayable MP4s.

nodes.title: ffmpeg capture via Python
nodes.summary: Use ffmpeg (avfoundation) launched from Python via subprocess as the capture method.

nodes.title: System audio capture
nodes.summary: Capture system audio through the BlackHole 2ch virtual driver with a Multi-Output Device so the user can still hear audio. Optionally evaluate ScreenCaptureKit as a driver-free alternative.

nodes.title: Low-CPU performance
nodes.summary: Use hardware encoding (h264_videotoolbox) to keep CPU usage low during dual capture.

nodes.title: Responsive UI
nodes.summary: Run compositing in a background thread so the interface never freezes.

nodes.title: Audio/video sync
nodes.summary: The two streams should start within a fraction of a second of each other, with a documented method for fine alignment (e.g. a clap marker) if drift occurs.

nodes.title: Device auto-detection
nodes.summary: Automatically find the camera, microphone, screen, and BlackHole indexes, or offer a settings dropdown, so the user never edits code.

nodes.title: Permission handling
nodes.summary: Detect missing Camera, Microphone, and Screen Recording permissions and show clear instructions for fixing them.

nodes.title: Helpful error messages
nodes.summary: Show clear messages for common problems: ffmpeg not installed, BlackHole missing, device not found, or low disk space.

nodes.title: Basic settings (nice to have)
nodes.summary: Allow configuring PiP size and position, output folder, and video quality.

nodes.title: Source code and README
nodes.summary: Deliver working Python source code with a README covering installation (ffmpeg, BlackHole, Python dependencies) and Multi-Output Device setup.

nodes.title: Requirements and one-command run
nodes.summary: Provide a requirements.txt and a one-command way to run the app.

nodes.title: Packaged .app (optional)
nodes.summary: Optionally provide a double-clickable .app built with py2app, including the required macOS privacy usage descriptions.

nodes.title: Acceptance: three playable files
nodes.summary: Clicking Record then Stop produces three playable files in a timestamped folder.

nodes.title: Acceptance: final video quality
nodes.summary: The final video shows the presenter at the bottom right, with both mic and system audio clearly audible and in sync.

nodes.title: Acceptance: macOS compatibility
nodes.summary: The app runs on a current macOS version (specify the minimum, e.g. macOS 13+) on Apple Silicon and on Intel if needed.

nodes.title: Acceptance: 30-minute stability
nodes.summary: A 30-minute recording completes without crashes, dropped audio, or the UI freezing.
